title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
description:
arXiv:2609.04304v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them.
